page.notes: The Greek word in question 11 (δίχοτομος) is read with doubt; the accent and the first letters are unclear. The sign ◡ before "Aqua" (14) and "Medicorum" (22) is an unidentified mark, not a letter; it is copied as a curved symbol with [?]. The word in 25 before "sitiant" is unclear at the start, as is the line-end hyphen after "as-". The catchword "Cur" at the foot belongs to question 26, which is printed there as "26. Cur". Hyphens at line ends (re-ctam, in-saniunt, so-leant, fa-me, ex-Liene, au-geri) are printed hyphens kept as in the scan.
